about: From the best passage's P(holds): below 0.32 search_more (on the bench 96% of such items were truly not answered, 77% on reworded twins); act 0.99 because no Series One threshold reached even 80% precision for sufficient (near misses score high), so sufficient is effectively never said; between, unsure. Add only: in act mode it could only add a retrieval step or an I-could-not-find line.
